git_gate: Caller must read back current Git files and supply exact run_files_sha256 with commit and expected_completed; local receipt is not a remote proof.
other_model_arms: Require a separate launch freeze; no Qwen/Falcon execution in this utility.
limitations: First-batch artifacts stay immutable. Cumulative run/ledger/summary advance; every batch stores immutable before/after copies.
Unknown/failed or interrupted batch requires review and is never automatically retried.
SIGKILL of the supervisor cannot be trapped; actual ledger reservations remain the source for unknown outcomes.
Completed generations are not factuality or steganographic success.
